'''jedimaster Courting Danger''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[jedimaster]]
* '''Published:''' 7 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile jedimaster DS 2003 Courting.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My attempt at a tournament worthy COTVG deck. Plz give input! Thanks

The published list has 55 cards.

== Strategy ==

Runs like a typical COTVG deck. Thinking about putting some Bounty's (CC) in, and maybe a couple more Hidden Weapons.

Is the space presence really needed in this deck or should I take out those 3 cards (Tat and two Indy ships) to put some more useful cards in? Should I (V) Krayt Dragon Bones?

Boba With Blaster Rifle is prob. gonna be replaced with Boba Fett (CC), adds to the forfeit (he will def. go in, if I put Bounties in)

Just lemme know what ya guys think...getting this and my Profit deck ready for a tourny in a couple weeks. Need all the input I can get.
